techcrunch.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plugin
techcrunch.description: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

techcrunch.title: The Enhanced Games — tech’s steroid extravaganza — didn’t pay off, as company posts $60 million loss
techcrunch.description: An effort to transform the world of sports through steroid use doesn't exactly seem to be bearing financial fruit.

techcrunch.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
techcrunch.description: Jason Kelce joked that people should cool data centers with their pee, rather than potable water -- but his suggestion is not completely ludicrous.

techcrunch.title: Someone targeted security researchers using a fake crypto conference as a lure
techcrunch.description: A hacker pretending to work for a leading cryptocurrency news website targeted several cybersecurity professionals using Google Docs as a way to deliver malware.

techcrunch.title: Mark buys a castle
techcrunch.description: Mark Zuckerberg just bought a cozy abode somewhat close to Meta’s international headquarters in Ireland.

techcrunch.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
techcrunch.description: Google is giving publishers a new button that lets readers make them a preferred source across Search, Discover, and Google News, potentially boosting their traffic as AI search sends fewer clicks to the web.

techcrunch.title: Runlayer, Rippling drop lawsuits — but the brouhaha is still a cautionary tale for founders
techcrunch.description: Runlayer and Rippling have dropped their lawsuits. No money was paid. Rippling celebrated by releasing a competing product.

techcrunch.title: Castelion hits $13B valuation to mass-produce hypersonic missiles
techcrunch.description: Founded in 2022, Castelion set out to manufacture hypersonic weapon systems at a lower cost and at faster speeds than traditional defense primes.

techcrunch.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
techcrunch.description: Linkdaze's smart digital calendar stands out for not putting its features behind a paywall, including an AI meal planner tool.

techcrunch.title: Grok keeps sending gibberish responses to users
techcrunch.description: Affected users told TechCrunch they were using Grok Lite, and noticed the issues as early as Wednesday morning.

techcrunch.title: The investor’s guide to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Everything you need to know
techcrunch.description: Year after year, investors who've explored the Expo Halls, met founders, and learned from peers have proven why you need to be on the ground at Disrupt this year.

techcrunch.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT’s launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
techcrunch.description: ChatGPT and other AI models are now authoring and editing much of the new web.

techcrunch.title: Early Cerebras investor Adit Singh joins Mayfield as infrastructure partner
techcrunch.description: At Mayfield, Singh will focus on semiconductor, cybersecurity, and physical AI investments.

techcrunch.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
techcrunch.description: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.

techcrunch.title: Senators demand answers from TikTok over experiment that disabled safeguards
techcrunch.description: The safeguard was designed to prevent users from being overwhelmed by harmful content, but TikTok wanted to determine whether it made the app less engaging.

techcrunch.title: Meta brings Pocket, an app that lets you vibe-code and share games, to US users
techcrunch.description: Meta is bringing Pocket, its experimental AI-powered app for creating and sharing interactive games, to users across the U.S. after quietly testing it in Brazil.

techcrunch.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield 200 is here — see who made the cut
techcrunch.description: We’re thrilled to unveil the 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, our annual handpicked list of the 200 most promising early-stage startups from around the world.

techcrunch.title: Patreon launches 30 new creator features, including short-form Clips and revamped discovery
techcrunch.description: Patreon is overhauling how creators get discovered, adding short-form Clips, topic-based communities, and a revamped recommendation system designed to give smaller creators more visibility.

techcrunch.title: Inertia Enterprises finds a way to make its fusion fuel fast
techcrunch.description: Fusion power startup Inertia Enterprises reduced the fuel filling process from a week to just a few hours. It's one of 10 hurdles the company must overcome to make a profitable power plant.

techcrunch.title: There are less than 48 hours to save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
techcrunch.description: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!
